selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler enter after moving through the mountains and plains in his mind?
questions.answer: He entered the world of trees and plants.

questions.question: What was he told to do in that world?
questions.answer: He was told to enter, look, and read its signs.

questions.question: In the first truth, what can be seen in each plant and tree?
questions.answer: Kind giving and care can be seen in each one.

questions.question: What are the three plant features named in the passage?
questions.answer: The features named are leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: According to the second truth, are plant differences just accidents?
questions.answer: No. They are shown as purposeful.

questions.question: In the second truth, what do the differences among plants teach us?
questions.answer: They teach us that plants are made with wisdom and not by accident.

questions.question: What words describe the way those plants come out?
questions.answer: They come out with order, balance, beauty, and life.

questions.question: What did the traveler say at the end?
questions.answer: He thanked Allah for the gift of faith.

questions.question: How did this study change the traveler’s heart and words?
questions.answer: It made him praise Allah for the blessing of faith.

questions.question: Which living things are the main focus of this passage?
questions.answer: Trees and plants.

questions.question: How did the plant world call him in?
questions.answer: It called him to come and inspect its world.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand from the look of the trees and plants?
questions.answer: He understood that their kinds were showing Allah’s oneness together.

questions.question: Which three things in fruit-bearing plants are spoken of like clear signs?
questions.answer: Their leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What is the second great truth about the many kinds of plants?
questions.answer: Their differences and beauty are made with wisdom and mercy.

questions.question: What is the main point of the second truth?
questions.answer: Plant variety and beauty are made wisely and on purpose.

questions.question: How do the plants come out from those seeds?
questions.answer: They come out in an orderly, balanced, and beautiful way.

questions.question: What qualities are seen when those plants grow?
questions.answer: Order, balance, beauty, life, and wise purpose are seen.

questions.question: What feeling filled the traveler at the end?
questions.answer: He felt thankful for belief.

questions.question: Where did the traveler go next in his thoughtful journey?
questions.answer: He went to the realm of trees and vegetables.

questions.question: What was he invited to do there?
questions.answer: He was invited to enter and study its signs.

questions.question: What new gate opened before the traveler?
questions.answer: The gate to the world of trees and plants opened.

questions.question: After the mountains and plains, what did the traveler begin to study?
questions.answer: He began to study trees and plants.

questions.question: What is amazing about the seeds in the third truth?
questions.answer: Seeds that look the same can grow into many different plants.

questions.question: What realm opened to the traveler in this passage?
questions.answer: The realm of trees and plants opened to him.
